reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. The original instruction, 'click on the picture of the day', did not distinguish the Picture of the day heading from the snowy landscape photo beneath it. The groundTruth covers the photo only, so clicking the identically named heading would not be accepted. Rewrote both instructions to identify the snowy landscape photo below the heading explicitly, retaining the existing image groundTruth.
